summary: This Form 8-K reports auction procedures for SLM Student Loan Trust 2006-7 Classes A-6B and A-6C notes. An affiliate of Navient Funding, LLC, the depositor, intends to submit hold orders for all currently held notes and buy bids for outstanding A-6C notes at 30-day SOFR + 1.50% p.a. These are routine operational updates for an asset-backed securities trust under its indenture terms, not a corporate event. No special situation is present; it is a standard current report for a structured finance vehicle.
